pages.title: Chibi Hatsune Miku and Kasane Teto Winter Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features chibi Hatsune Miku and Kasane Teto hugging in warm winter coats and scarves surrounded by falling snowflakes.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2010 Singing Into a Microphone on a Snowflake Concert Stage Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku 2010 sings into a microphone in this printable coloring page, extending her free hand above a large snowflake on the concert stage. Snowflake motifs repeat across her twin tails, tie, skirt, and boots. Curved railings and suspended decorations surround the figure, adding smaller shapes around the coloring sheet's broad hair and clothing sections.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2011 Wearing Earmuffs and Mittens While Building a Snowman Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Snow Miku 2011 building a snowman while wearing earmuffs and mittens, with a small scarf-wearing rabbit sitting beside her. Her hands rest on the snowman's rounded head above its carrot nose and smiling mouth. Snowflake patterns, fringed scarves, twig arms, and two large buttons add detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Snow Miku and Rabbit Yukine Visiting Her Snow Sculpture at Sapporo Snow Festival Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku and Rabbit Yukine visit her snow sculpture at Sapporo Snow Festival in this printable coloring page, with a tower rising behind them. Miku gestures toward the oversized seated sculpture while Yukine lifts one paw. Rope barriers, distant visitors, and snow-covered trees fill the scene around the coloring sheet's patterned winter clothes and long twin tails.

pages.title: Snow Miku Riding the Snow Miku Streetcar Through Snowy Sapporo Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page follows Snow Miku riding her streetcar through snowy Sapporo, leaning at an open window with a rabbit companion beside her. Overhead wires and curving tracks lead toward a distant tower between buildings and snowy trees. The coloring sheet combines broad streetcar panels and flowing hair with finer window frames, snowflakes, and interior hand straps.

pages.title: Snow Miku Holding Rabbit Yukine Beside a Snow-covered Fir Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku holds Rabbit Yukine beside a snow-covered fir tree in this printable coloring page, wearing earmuffs, mittens, and a long scarf decorated with snowflakes. Yukine sits between her hands with its ears upright. The coloring sheet leaves generous spaces in the tree's layered branches and Miku's twin tails, with smaller bows and pom-poms on her boots.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2012 Fluffy Coat Wearing Her Jeweled Ribbon in a Snowy Winter Garden Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Snow Miku 2012 Fluffy Coat wearing a jeweled hair ribbon in a winter garden, with snow resting on bare branches. Matching gems, bows, and dangling snowflake chains decorate her cape and boots. A small rabbit in a coordinating outfit stands near her feet, adding rounded shapes to the coloring sheet's detailed costume.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2012 Fluffy Coat Clearing Snow with a Shovel Beside an Ice Sculpture Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku 2012 Fluffy Coat clears snow with a wide shovel in this printable coloring page, standing beside an ice sculpture shaped like herself. A bundled rabbit sits nearby while her mittens grip the shovel handle. Jeweled bows and snowflake patterns provide small enclosed details among the coloring sheet's larger coat panels, hair sections, and snowdrifts.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2013 Strawberry White Kimono Holding a Japanese Umbrella Beneath Falling Snow Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Snow Miku 2013 Strawberry White Kimono holding a Japanese umbrella beneath falling snow, with a rabbit beside her sandals. Strawberries, flowers, and snowflakes decorate the kimono and hood, while tassels hang near her twin tails. The umbrella's many ribs create narrow sections above the coloring sheet's flowing sleeves and snowy landscape.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2013 Strawberry White Kimono Sitting Beside a Snow Bunny on a Winter Veranda Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku 2013 Strawberry White Kimono sits beside a snow bunny on a winter veranda in this printable coloring page, with her hands folded together. Strawberry and snowflake patterns cover her wide sleeves and draped skirt. Wooden floorboards, a garden lantern, and snow-laden branches frame the coloring sheet, while the rabbit wears a small cape and floral ornaments.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2013 Strawberry White Kimono Enjoying Strawberry Sweets at a Low Tea Table Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Snow Miku 2013 Strawberry White Kimono enjoying a strawberry sweet at a low tea table beside a rabbit companion. More sweets rest on a plate next to a flower-decorated cup and saucer. Repeated fruit, blossom, and snowflake motifs fill her kimono, with umbrella ribs and a flowering branch completing the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2014 Magical Snow Casting a Snowflake Spell with Her Magic Wand Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku 2014 Magical Snow casts a snowflake spell in this printable coloring page, raising her magic wand while holding an open spellbook nearby. Her oversized pointed hat carries a bow and snowflake emblem, and a rabbit stands beside her boots. The coloring sheet includes layered ruffles, diamond decorations, and zigzag ribbons around the sweeping twin tails.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2014 Magical Snow Reading Her Spellbook with Rabbit Yukine Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Snow Miku 2014 Magical Snow reading her spellbook with Rabbit Yukine, seated beneath a wide witch hat decorated with snowflakes. Yukine rests its paws on the open book while Miku holds both covers. Bows, scalloped cape edges, ribbon details, and large snowflake cover designs divide the coloring sheet into varied enclosed areas.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2014 Magical Snow Hugging Rabbit Yukine Beneath Her Oversized Witch Hat Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku 2014 Magical Snow hugs Rabbit Yukine in this printable coloring page, smiling beneath an oversized witch hat with a large snowflake bow. Yukine's ears stretch across her shoulder beside a ribboned magic staff. Snowflakes and diamond motifs cover the cape and layered skirt, leaving long sweeping hair sections around the coloring sheet's smaller decorations.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2015 Snow Bell Sheltering Rabbit Yukine Beneath a Leaf Umbrella Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Snow Miku 2015 Snow Bell sheltering Rabbit Yukine beneath a broad leaf umbrella, crouching beside the rabbit in matching capes. Bell-shaped flowers hang from the umbrella stem and her hair ornaments. The coloring sheet includes scalloped skirt layers, leaf-shaped panels, fluffy cuffs, and small bows around the large curved leaf.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2015 Snow Bell Ringing Lily of the Valley Bells Shaped Like a Treble Clef Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku 2015 Snow Bell rings lily-of-the-valley bells on a treble-clef-shaped stem in this printable coloring page, with Rabbit Yukine raising one paw nearby. More bell flowers hang from her hair, skirt, and boots. Layered leaf shapes create broad costume sections, while floral edging and small ribbon ornaments add finer details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2015 Snow Bell Offering a Lily of the Valley Flower to Rabbit Yukine Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Snow Miku 2015 Snow Bell offering a lily-of-the-valley flower to Rabbit Yukine, leaning forward as the rabbit looks up. Rows of bell-shaped blooms decorate her headband, cape, and leaf-layered skirt. Her fluffy cuffs and long twin tails frame the pair, with small bows and flower outlines throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2016 Snow Owl Skiing Down a Snowy Mountain with Musical Note Ski Poles Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku 2016 Snow Owl skis down a snowy mountain in this printable coloring page, holding poles while wearing an owl hat and raised goggles. Her buckled boots sit on snowflake-decorated skis, and a rabbit in matching headgear follows beside her. Mountain peaks, fir trees, and flying snow surround the coloring sheet's winter outfit details.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2016 Snow Owl Snowboarding Along a Gentle Slope Beneath Snowy Pine Trees Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Snow Miku 2016 Snow Owl snowboarding down a gentle slope beneath snowy pine trees, extending both arms for balance. Her owl hat, goggles, fringed scarf, and strapped boots accompany a board decorated with snowflakes and diamonds. A rabbit bounds beside the board, with sweeping twin tails and drifting snow filling the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2016 Snow Owl Having a Snowball Fight with Rabbit Yukine Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku 2016 Snow Owl has a snowball fight with Rabbit Yukine in this printable coloring page, holding a snowball high beside her owl hat. Yukine peeks over a mound of snow wearing goggles and earmuffs. Scattered snowballs, distant fir trees, and the snowflake-patterned mittens and scarf add scene-specific details around the coloring sheet's large figure.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2016 Snow Owl Riding a Ski Lift Above a Snowy Mountain Resort Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Snow Miku 2016 Snow Owl riding a ski lift above a mountain resort, seated beside a rabbit wearing matching goggles. Her mittens rest on the safety bar, and her laced boots hang over the snowy landscape. Receding lift chairs, wooded slopes, and clustered buildings give the coloring sheet smaller background sections.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2017 Twinkle Snow Conducting a Starry Performance with a Baton and Icy Music Stand Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku 2017 Twinkle Snow conducts a starry performance in this printable coloring page, holding a raised baton beside an icy music stand and score. Stars, bead chains, and diamond ornaments decorate her long cape and twin tails. Rabbit Yukine lifts a paw below her, while constellation lines and snowflake shapes add intricate areas to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2017 Twinkle Snow Having a Tea Party with Rabbit Yukine at a Star-covered Table Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Snow Miku 2017 Twinkle Snow having tea with Rabbit Yukine at a star-covered table, each holding a decorated cup. A matching teapot and tiered stand of small sweets sit between them. Dangling stars, bead chains, ornate chair backs, and scalloped table edges create many enclosed details across the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2017 Twinkle Snow Resting on a Snow Cloud with a Star-shaped Cushion Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku 2017 Twinkle Snow rests on a snow cloud in this printable coloring page, hugging a star-shaped cushion with Rabbit Yukine seated beside her. Her cape and hair ornaments carry star chains, snowflakes, and dangling diamonds. The cloud's rounded outline and broad cushion contrast with the coloring sheet's smaller ribbons, beads, and fur-edged boots.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2018 Crane Priestess Performing a Shrine Dance with a Folding Fan and Kagura Bell Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Snow Miku 2018 Crane Priestess performing a shrine dance, lifting a folding fan and a tiered kagura bell in both hands. Crane motifs spread across her wide sleeves and the open fan. Knotted cords, tassels, a long pleated skirt, and a rabbit companion provide additional details on the coloring sheet's wooden platform.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2018 Crane Priestess Sweeping a Snowy Shrine Path Beneath a Torii Gate Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku 2018 Crane Priestess sweeps a snowy shrine path in this printable coloring page, gripping a broom beneath a broad snow-topped torii gate. Crane designs spread across her long sleeves below a bird-shaped hood. Paired stone lanterns, knotted tassels, paving stones, and a small rabbit create smaller details around the coloring sheet's flowing robes.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2018 Crane Priestess Kneeling in Prayer Beside a Shrine Offering Stand Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Snow Miku 2018 Crane Priestess kneeling in prayer beside a shrine offering stand, with her palms together and eyes closed. A thick hanging rope and tassel frame the stand beside her. Crane-patterned sleeves, snowflake hair decorations, and a seated rabbit divide the coloring sheet into broad folds and finer ornamental sections.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2018 Crane Priestess Holding an Ice Crane Beside a Red-crowned Crane in the Snow Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku 2018 Crane Priestess holds a small ice crane beside a red-crowned crane in this printable coloring page, surrounded by snow-covered branches and drifts. The large bird bends its long neck toward her cupped hands. Crane motifs, knotted cords, and tassels decorate her flowing robes, with feather outlines adding detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2019 Snow Princess Holding Her Royal Staff at the Entrance to an Ice Palace Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Snow Miku 2019 Snow Princess holding her royal staff at an ice palace entrance, framed by pointed arches and crystals. Her crown, layered gown, and curled twin tails carry roses, beads, and snowflakes. A rabbit sits beside the tall staff, whose circular snowflake head adds another detailed section to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2019 Snow Princess Carrying a Rose Bouquet on a Snowy Castle Balcony Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku 2019 Snow Princess carries a rose bouquet on a snowy castle balcony in this printable coloring page, smiling beside a rabbit on the railing. More roses decorate her twin tails and layered gown beneath a snowflake crown. Distant towers, fir trees, and mountains surround the coloring sheet's broad ruffles and smaller bead chains.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2019 Snow Princess Brushing Her Twin Tails at a Mirror with Rabbit Yukine Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Snow Miku 2019 Snow Princess brushing her twin tails at a mirror, with Rabbit Yukine seated on the dressing table. Her snowflake hairbrush and reflected curls sit beneath a crown and rose-trimmed bows. The coloring sheet includes layered skirt ruffles, bead chains, a decorative stool, and small bottles beside the ornate mirror.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2020 Snow Parade Leading a Winter Marching Parade with Her Baton Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku 2020 Snow Parade leads a winter marching parade in this printable coloring page, raising a ribboned baton while a rabbit carries a flag. Her tall pom-pom hat, shoulder epaulettes, and buttoned jacket display snowflakes and musical symbols. Streetlamps, banner ropes, snowy fir trees, and a clock tower complete the coloring sheet around her lifted step.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2020 Snow Parade Playing a French Horn Beside Rabbit Yukine Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Snow Miku 2020 Snow Parade playing a French horn beside Rabbit Yukine, who raises a small flag with a musical note. The horn's coiled tubing and valves cross her buttoned marching outfit. Snowflake ornaments, shoulder cords, a pom-pom hat, and long ribbons provide varied details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2021 Glowing Snow Singing From Her Songbook Beneath Winter Illuminations Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku 2021 Glowing Snow sings from her songbook beneath winter illuminations in this printable coloring page, with hanging stars and garlands behind her. Clock ornaments and dangling diamonds decorate her beret, cape, and twin tails. A rabbit wearing matching accessories stands nearby, while the book's snowflake and star covers add distinct shapes to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2021 Glowing Snow Wearing Her Clock Beret Beside a Snow-covered Clock Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Snow Miku 2021 Glowing Snow wearing her clock beret beside a snow-covered clock tower, extending one hand toward the viewer. Small clock faces, diamond pendants, and snowflakes decorate her cape, skirt, and boots. A rabbit reaches upward beside her, with large flowing hair sections framing the coloring sheet's detailed winter outfit.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2021 Glowing Snow Wrapping Rabbit Yukine in Her Cape on a Snowy Park Bench Coloring Page
pages.description: Snow Miku 2021 Glowing Snow wraps Rabbit Yukine in her cape in this printable coloring page, seated on a snowy park bench with her legs crossed. Yukine nestles between her hands beneath a snowflake-patterned cape edge. Clock bows, diamond ornaments, bare branches, and a nearby streetlamp add smaller details around the coloring sheet's large seated figure.

pages.title: Snow Miku 2022 Grand Voyage Steering a Ship Through the Winter Sea Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Snow Miku 2022 Grand Voyage steering a ship through the winter sea, holding a large spoked wheel beside a rabbit. Her captain's hat carries a crab emblem, and anchor decorations repeat across her winter outfit. A hanging lantern, ropes, deck railings, and distant mountain shores complete the coloring sheet's nautical scene.
